title.zh: 她请我们吃了北京烤鸭
title.en: She treated us to Peking Duck

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你们是什么时候到北京的？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen shì shénme shíhou dào Běijīng de?
lines.en: When did you get to Beijing?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我们是昨天到的。朋友来机场接我们。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen shì zuótiān dào de. Péngyou lái jīchǎng jiē wǒmen.
lines.en: We arrived yesterday. A friend met us at the airport.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你们是来旅游的吧？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen shì lái lǚyóu de ba?
lines.en: You're here to travel, I suppose?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 对。朋友还请我们吃了北京烤鸭。
lines.pinyin: Duì. Péngyou hái qǐng wǒmen chīle Běijīng Kǎoyā.
lines.en: Yes. Our friend also treated us to Peking Duck.

texts.scene: Asking for help with a word.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 不好意思，这个字是什么意思？
lines.pinyin: Bù hǎoyìsi, zhège zì shì shénme yìsi?
lines.en: Excuse me, what does this character mean?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我也不懂。老师让我们问他。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ yě bù dǒng. Lǎoshī ràng wǒmen wèn tā.
lines.en: I don't understand it either. The teacher told us to ask him.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 谢谢你帮忙！
lines.pinyin: Xièxie nǐ bāngmáng!
lines.en: Thanks for your help!

grammar.name: The particle 吧 (2)
grammar.explanation: 吧 at the end of a sentence can show a guess. The speaker thinks something is true and wants it confirmed.

grammar.name: The 是……的 sentence
grammar.explanation: Use 是……的 to stress when, where or how a past event happened. Put the stressed detail after 是.

grammar.name: Pivotal sentences
grammar.explanation: The object of the first verb is also the subject of the second verb. Verbs like 让 and 请 often start this pattern.

examples.en: The teacher told us to ask him.
A friend invited me to a meal.

exercises.explanation: 是……的 stresses when something happened.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 让 starts a pivotal sentence: mum tells me to do something.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: The stressed detail, 昨天, comes after 是.

exercises.prompt: A friend invited me to a meal.
exercises.explanation: 我 is the object of 请 and the subject of 吃饭.

title.en: Let's take a taxi to Peking University instead

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我们怎么去北京大学？坐公交车吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen zěnme qù Běijīng Dàxué? Zuò gōngjiāochē ma?
lines.en: How shall we get to Peking University? By bus?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 车站太远了。我们还是打车吧。
lines.pinyin: Chēzhàn tài yuǎn le. Wǒmen háishi dǎchē ba.
lines.en: The stop is too far. Let's take a taxi instead.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 好。我想买的东西也在那儿。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ xiǎng mǎi de dōngxi yě zài nàr.
lines.en: Okay. The things I want to buy are there too.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这间教室有多少人？
lines.pinyin: Zhè jiān jiàoshì yǒu duōshao rén?
lines.en: How many people are in this classroom?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 有二十多名学生，都是外国人。
lines.pinyin: Yǒu èrshí duō míng xuéshēng, dōu shì wàiguó rén.
lines.en: Over twenty students, all from abroad.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 啊，别过来，老师来了！
lines.pinyin: À, bié guòlái, lǎoshī lái le!
lines.en: Oh, don't come over, the teacher is here!

grammar.name: The pattern 还是……吧
grammar.explanation: After comparing choices, 还是……吧 gives the option you prefer: "let's... instead".

grammar.name: Approximate numbers with 多
grammar.explanation: 多 after a round number means "more than".

grammar.name: Verb phrases as attributives
grammar.explanation: A verb phrase or subject-verb phrase can describe a noun. Put it before 的.

examples.en: the things I want to buy
the people who come to Beijing

exercises.prompt: 车站太远了，我们（　）打车吧。
exercises.explanation: 还是……吧 gives the preferred option.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 多 after a round number means "more than".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 吧 ends the suggestion.

exercises.prompt: the things I want to buy
exercises.explanation: The describing phrase goes before 的.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 今天的事你做完了吗？
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān de shì nǐ zuòwán le ma?
lines.en: Have you finished today's work?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 做完了。我想去西安旅游，你和我一起去吗？
lines.pinyin: Zuòwán le. Wǒ xiǎng qù Xī'ān lǚyóu, nǐ hé wǒ yìqǐ qù ma?
lines.en: Yes. I want to visit Xi'an. Will you come with me?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 为什么去那儿？
lines.pinyin: Wèi shénme qù nàr?
lines.en: Why go there?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 那儿的东西不错。你看看这个。
lines.pinyin: Nàr de dōngxi búcuò. Nǐ kànkan zhège.
lines.en: There are nice things there. Have a look at this.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你累了吧？洗洗手，休息休息。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ lèi le ba? Xǐxi shǒu, xiūxi xiūxi.
lines.en: You must be tired. Wash your hands and have a rest.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 好。我每天都这么忙！
lines.pinyin: Hǎo. Wǒ měi tiān dōu zhème máng!
lines.en: Okay. I'm this busy every day!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你昨天休息了一下，今天还累吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuótiān xiūxile yíxià, jīntiān hái lèi ma?
lines.en: You rested a bit yesterday. Are you still tired today?

grammar.name: Complement of result
grammar.explanation: A verb or adjective right after a verb shows the result of the action. The negative uses 没.

grammar.name: Verb reduplication (1)
grammar.explanation: Repeating a verb makes an action sound short, casual or like a try. It is common in speech.

grammar.name: Verb reduplication (2)
grammar.explanation: For things already done, a one-syllable verb becomes A了A. A two-syllable verb normally uses AB了一下. A separable verb becomes A了AB.

exercises.explanation: 完 after a verb shows the action is finished.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: Repeating the verb makes it casual: 看看.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 完 goes right after the verb.
Past actions use A了A.

title.en: You look pretty good in red

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这条红色的裤子你试过吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhè tiáo hóngsè de kùzi nǐ shìguo ma?
lines.en: Have you tried these red trousers?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 试过。我穿红色的不好看，还是黑色的好。
lines.pinyin: Shìguo. Wǒ chuān hóngsè de bù hǎokàn, háishi hēisè de hǎo.
lines.en: Yes. Red doesn't suit me. Black is better.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 白色的呢？更好看！
lines.pinyin: Báisè de ne? Gèng hǎokàn!
lines.en: What about the white ones? Even nicer!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你去过商场吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qùguo shāngchǎng ma?
lines.en: Have you been to the mall?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 没去过。因为太远，所以我在网上买书包。
lines.pinyin: Méi qùguo. Yīnwèi tài yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒ zài wǎngshang mǎi shūbāo.
lines.en: No. It's too far, so I buy school bags online.

grammar.name: The aspect particle 过
grammar.explanation: 过 after a verb shows that something has happened at some time in the past. The negative is 没 + verb + 过.

grammar.name: 因为……，所以……
grammar.explanation: This pair links a cause with its result.

examples.pinyin: Yīnwèi tài yuǎn, suǒyǐ wǒ bú qù.
examples.en: It's too far, so I'm not going.

grammar.name: The 的 phrase
grammar.explanation: Adding 的 after a word can replace a noun that is already understood.

exercises.explanation: 过 after a verb shows past experience.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 因为 gives the reason and 所以 gives the result.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 没 + verb + 过 is the negative.
红色的 stands for the red clothes.

title.en: Visiting a Chinese friend's home for the first time

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你到了吗？我下去接你。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dào le ma? Wǒ xiàqù jiē nǐ.
lines.en: Are you here? I'll go down and meet you.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 到了，我在下面。这是给你奶奶和爷爷的礼物。
lines.pinyin: Dào le, wǒ zài xiàmian. Zhè shì gěi nǐ nǎinai hé yéye de lǐwù.
lines.en: Yes, I'm downstairs. This is a gift for your grandparents.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 谢谢！快上来，进来吧！
lines.pinyin: Xièxie! Kuài shànglái, jìnlái ba!
lines.en: Thanks! Come up quickly, come in!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 等一会儿，我去拿面。
lines.pinyin: Děng yíhuìr, wǒ qù ná miàn.
lines.en: Wait a moment, I'll go and get the noodles.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 都八点了，我们走吧。
lines.pinyin: Dōu bā diǎn le, wǒmen zǒu ba.
lines.en: It's already eight, let's go.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 别走，晚饭准备好了！
lines.pinyin: Bié zǒu, wǎnfàn zhǔnbèi hǎo le!
lines.en: Don't leave, dinner is ready!

grammar.name: Simple complement of direction (1)
grammar.explanation: 来 after a verb means the movement is towards the speaker. 去 means it is away from the speaker.

grammar.name: Simple complement of direction (2)
grammar.explanation: A place goes before 来 or 去. A thing can go before or after them.

examples.en: He brought a cup of tea.

grammar.name: The pattern 都……了
grammar.explanation: 都……了 stresses that something is later or more than expected.

exercises.explanation: 来 shows movement towards the speaker, who is upstairs.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 都……了 means "already".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: A place goes before 去.
都 comes first and 了 ends the sentence.

words.meaning: links an adverbial to a verb

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 生日快乐！这是给你的画笔。
lines.pinyin: Shēngrì kuàilè! Zhè shì gěi nǐ de huàbǐ.
lines.en: Happy birthday! These paintbrushes are for you.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 谢谢！我打开看看。太好了！
lines.pinyin: Xièxie! Wǒ dǎkāi kànkan. Tài hǎo le!
lines.en: Thanks! I'll open it and see. Great!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我们吃蛋糕、肉、鱼什么的吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen chī dàngāo, ròu, yú shénme de ba.
lines.en: Let's eat cake, meat, fish and so on.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你怎么还在床上？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zěnme hái zài chuáng shang?
lines.en: Why are you still in bed?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 今天休息，我想好好地睡觉。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān xiūxi, wǒ xiǎng hǎohǎo de shuìjiào.
lines.en: It's my day off, I want to sleep well.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 别忘了，下午我们还要走一会儿。
lines.pinyin: Bié wàng le, xiàwǔ wǒmen hái yào zǒu yíhuìr.
lines.en: Don't forget, we're going for a walk this afternoon.

grammar.name: Adjective reduplication
grammar.explanation: Repeating an adjective makes the description more vivid. It often adds liking.

grammar.name: The set phrase 什么的
grammar.explanation: 什么的 goes after a list and means "and so on".

examples.en: cake, meat, fish and so on

grammar.name: The structural particle 地
grammar.explanation: 地 links a describing word to the verb that follows it.

exercises.explanation: 什么的 ends a list.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 地 goes before a verb.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: Describing word, 地, then the verb.
别 means "don't".

words.meaning: links a verb to how it is done

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你的爱好是什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de àihào shì shénme?
lines.en: What's your hobby?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我喜欢运动。我打篮球，也踢足球。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ xǐhuan yùndòng. Wǒ dǎ lánqiú, yě tī zúqiú.
lines.en: I like sports. I play basketball and football too.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你打得怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dǎ de zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How well do you play?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我打得不好，我哥哥打得很好。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ dǎ de bù hǎo, wǒ gēge dǎ de hěn hǎo.
lines.en: I don't play well, but my brother plays very well.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你游泳游得真快！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yóuyǒng yóu de zhēn kuài!
lines.en: You swim really fast!

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 谢谢。我一到这儿就开始游。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie. Wǒ yí dào zhèr jiù kāishǐ yóu.
lines.en: Thanks. I start swimming as soon as I get here.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我们从明天开始一起跑步吧。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen cóng míngtiān kāishǐ yìqǐ pǎobù ba.
lines.en: Let's start running together from tomorrow.

grammar.name: The pattern 一……就……
grammar.explanation: This shows that one thing happens right after another.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ yí dào jiā jiù xiūxi.
examples.en: I rest as soon as I get home.

grammar.name: Complement of state (1)
grammar.explanation: 得 after a verb is followed by a description of how the action goes. The negative puts 不 before the adjective.

grammar.name: Complement of state (2)
grammar.explanation: With an object or a separable verb, repeat the verb, or move the object to the front.

examples.pinyin: Tā dǎ lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.
Tā lánqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo.

exercises.explanation: 得 links a verb to how it is done.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 一……就…… means "as soon as".
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: With an object, the verb is repeated before 得.

exercises.prompt: I rest as soon as I get home.
exercises.explanation: 一 and 就 link the two actions.

title.zh: 虽然你忘了，但是我记得
title.en: Even though you forgot, I remembered

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 今天几号？你记得吗？
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān jǐ hào? Nǐ jìde ma?
lines.en: What's the date today? Do you remember?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 虽然你忘了，但是我记得！这些花是给你的。
lines.pinyin: Suīrán nǐ wàng le, dànshì wǒ jìde! Zhèxiē huā shì gěi nǐ de.
lines.en: Though you forgot, I remembered! These flowers are for you.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 真漂亮！你是很好的丈夫。
lines.pinyin: Zhēn piàoliang! Nǐ shì hěn hǎo de zhàngfu.
lines.en: So pretty! You're a very good husband.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 这个饭馆比那个大。
lines.pinyin: Zhège fànguǎn bǐ nàge dà.
lines.en: This restaurant is bigger than that one.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 但是那个更便宜。
lines.pinyin: Dànshì nàge gèng piányi.
lines.en: But that one is even cheaper.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 好，我们去左边的那个，点几个菜。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, wǒmen qù zuǒbian de nàge, diǎn jǐ ge cài.
lines.en: Okay, let's go to the one on the left and order some dishes.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (1)
grammar.explanation: Use 比 to compare two things: A 比 B + adjective.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (2)
grammar.explanation: With 比, don't use 很 or 非常 before the adjective. Use 还 or 更 for "even more".

examples.en: Today is even colder than yesterday.

grammar.name: 虽然……，但是……
grammar.explanation: This pair means "although... (still)". English uses only one of the two words, but Chinese can use both.

examples.zh: 虽然你忘了，但是我记得。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán nǐ wàng le, dànshì wǒ jìde.

exercises.explanation: A 比 B + adjective compares two things.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: After 比, use 更, not 很 or 非常.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: A 比 B + adjective.
虽然 first, 但是 second.

title.en: I'm going to buy a cup of bubble tea

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我去买杯奶茶，你要喝吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qù mǎi bēi nǎichá, nǐ yào hē ma?
lines.en: I'm going to buy a milk tea. Do you want one?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我喝咖啡。店离这儿远吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ hē kāfēi. Diàn lí zhèr yuǎn ma?
lines.en: I'll have coffee. Is the shop far from here?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 很近，就在学校门口旁边，走路五分钟。
lines.pinyin: Hěn jìn, jiù zài xuéxiào ménkǒu pángbiān, zǒulù wǔ fēnzhōng.
lines.en: It's close, right next to the school gate, a five-minute walk.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你哥哥个子高吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ gēge gèzi gāo ma?
lines.en: Is your older brother tall?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我没有他那么高。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ méiyǒu tā nàme gāo.
lines.en: I'm not as tall as him.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你们每周打几个小时球？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen měi zhōu dǎ jǐ ge xiǎoshí qiú?
lines.en: How many hours a week do you play ball?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我们打两个小时。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen dǎ liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
lines.en: We play for two hours.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (3)
grammar.explanation: 没有 compares and means "not as... as": A 没有 B + adjective. You can add 这么 or 那么.

examples.en: My sister isn't as tall as my brother.

grammar.name: The verb 离
grammar.explanation: 离 gives the distance between two places or times.

examples.en: The school is close to here.

grammar.name: Complement of duration (1)
grammar.explanation: A length of time goes after the verb to show how long something lasts.

exercises.explanation: 离 gives the distance between places.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: A 没有 B means A is not as... as B.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: The length of time goes after the verb.

exercises.prompt: My sister isn't as tall as my brother.
exercises.explanation: A 没有 B + adjective.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 快要考试了，你准备好了吗？
lines.pinyin: Kuàiyào kǎoshì le, nǐ zhǔnbèi hǎo le ma?
lines.en: The exam is coming. Are you ready?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 没有。这些题错了吗？
lines.pinyin: Méiyǒu. Zhèxiē tí cuò le ma?
lines.en: No. Are these answers wrong?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 我帮你看看。这个词你写错了。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ bāng nǐ kànkan. Zhège cí nǐ xiě cuò le.
lines.en: Let me help you look. You wrote this word wrongly.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你是今天开学还是明天开学？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ shì jīntiān kāixué háishi míngtiān kāixué?
lines.en: Does school start today or tomorrow?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 明天。我们班人很多，就要上学了，真高兴！
lines.pinyin: Míngtiān. Wǒmen bān rén hěn duō, jiù yào shàngxué le, zhēn gāoxìng!
lines.en: Tomorrow. Our class is big, and school is about to start. I'm so happy!

grammar.name: Subject-predicate phrases as predicates
grammar.explanation: The predicate can itself be a small subject + predicate. This describes one part of the main subject.

grammar.name: Alternative questions
grammar.explanation: Use 还是 between two choices to ask which one is true.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ hē chá háishi hē kāfēi?
examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

grammar.name: The pattern 要/快/快要/就要……了
grammar.explanation: These show that something will happen soon. Time words can go before 就要, but not before 快要.

exercises.explanation: 还是 in a question offers a choice.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: A time word can go before 就要.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 快要 and 了 wrap the event.
个子很高 is the predicate.

title.en: I like Chinese food the most

words.meaning: on the road, on the way
shows a continuing action or state

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你最喜欢吃什么？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan chī shénme?
lines.en: What do you like eating most?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我最喜欢吃中国菜。饭店门开着吗？
lines.pinyin: Wǒ zuì xǐhuan chī Zhōngguó cài. Fàndiàn mén kāizhe ma?
lines.en: I like Chinese food the most. Is the restaurant open?

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 开着。路上还下着雨，我们快进去吧。
lines.pinyin: Kāizhe. Lùshang hái xiàzhe yǔ, wǒmen kuài jìnqù ba.
lines.en: Yes. It's still raining out, let's go in quickly.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你头疼吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ tóu téng ma?
lines.en: Do you have a headache?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 有点儿疼。我经常这样。
lines.pinyin: Yǒudiǎnr téng. Wǒ jīngcháng zhèyàng.
lines.en: A little. I'm often like this.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 别动，我去药店买药。
lines.pinyin: Bié dòng, wǒ qù yàodiàn mǎi yào.
lines.en: Don't move, I'll go to the pharmacy for some medicine.

grammar.name: The aspect particle 着 (1)
grammar.explanation: 着 after a verb shows that an action or state is continuing. The negative is 没(有) before the verb.

grammar.name: The aspect particle 着 (2)
grammar.explanation: The object goes after 着.

grammar.name: The adverb 最
grammar.explanation: 最 means "the most". It goes before an adjective or a verb like 喜欢.

examples.en: I like Chinese food the most.

exercises.explanation: 着 shows a continuing state.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 最 goes before the verb.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: The object goes after 着.

exercises.prompt: I like Chinese food the most.
exercises.explanation: 最 goes before 喜欢.

title.en: It's much colder here than in Beijing

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你那儿天气怎么样？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ nàr tiānqì zěnmeyàng?
lines.en: How's the weather where you are?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 今天阴，比北京冷多了。
lines.pinyin: Jīntiān yīn, bǐ Běijīng lěng duō le.
lines.en: It's cloudy today, much colder than Beijing.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 北京很晴，外面很舒服。
lines.pinyin: Běijīng hěn qíng, wàimiàn hěn shūfu.
lines.en: Beijing is sunny, it's lovely outside.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你弟弟从小就喜欢运动。
lines.pinyin: Nǐ dìdi cóngxiǎo jiù xǐhuan yùndòng.
lines.en: Your younger brother has loved sports since he was small.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 他跑得比我快得多。
lines.pinyin: Tā pǎo de bǐ wǒ kuài de duō.
lines.en: He runs much faster than me.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 他坐地铁比我走得早。
lines.pinyin: Tā zuò dìtiě bǐ wǒ zǒu de zǎo.
lines.en: He takes the subway and leaves earlier than me.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (4)
grammar.explanation: 多了 or 得多 after the adjective shows a big difference.

examples.pinyin: Jīntiān bǐ zuótiān rè duō le.
examples.en: Today is much hotter than yesterday.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (5)
grammar.explanation: With a complement of state, 比 can go before the verb or after 得.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiě de bǐ tā kuài.
Wǒ bǐ tā xiě de kuài.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (6)
grammar.explanation: When the verb also has an object, move the object forward or repeat the verb.

examples.pinyin: Tā zúqiú bǐ wǒ tī de hǎo.
examples.en: He plays football better than me.

examples.pinyin: Tā tī zúqiú bǐ wǒ tī de hǎo.
examples.en: He plays football better than me.

exercises.explanation: 多了 after the adjective shows a big difference.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 得 links the verb to the description.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: It's much colder here than in Beijing.
exercises.explanation: 多了 follows the adjective.
比 can follow 得.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你们班有多少人？
lines.pinyin: Nǐmen bān yǒu duōshao rén?
lines.en: How many people are in your class?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我们班比他们班多五个人。老师教我们中文。
lines.pinyin: Wǒmen bān bǐ tāmen bān duō wǔ ge rén. Lǎoshī jiāo wǒmen Zhōngwén.
lines.en: Our class has five more people than theirs. The teacher teaches us Chinese.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 中文课有意思吗？
lines.pinyin: Zhōngwén kè yǒu yìsi ma?
lines.en: Is Chinese class interesting?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 很有意思。我们都爱上中文课！
lines.pinyin: Hěn yǒu yìsi. Wǒmen dōu ài shàng Zhōngwén kè!
lines.en: Very. We all love going to Chinese class!

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 新年快乐！我送给你一个本子。
lines.pinyin: Xīnnián kuàilè! Wǒ sònggěi nǐ yí ge běnzi.
lines.en: Happy New Year! I'm giving you a notebook.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 谢谢！可能比我的贵一点儿。
lines.pinyin: Xièxie! Kěnéng bǐ wǒ de guì yìdiǎnr.
lines.en: Thanks! It may be a little more expensive than mine.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 希望你喜欢！
lines.pinyin: Xīwàng nǐ xǐhuan!
lines.en: I hope you like it!

grammar.name: Double-object sentences (2)
grammar.explanation: Verbs such as 拿, 送 and 卖 can add 给, then take a person and a thing.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ sònggěi tā yì běn shū.
Tā màigěi wǒ liǎng ge píngguǒ.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (7)
grammar.explanation: A number phrase after the adjective gives the exact difference: A 比 B + adjective + number.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēge bǐ wǒ dà liǎng suì.
examples.en: My brother is two years older than me.

grammar.name: Comparative sentences (8)
grammar.explanation: 一点儿 or 一些 after the adjective shows a small difference.

examples.en: My sister is a little taller than me.

exercises.explanation: 送 adds 给 before the person.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 一点儿 after the adjective shows a small difference.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.prompt: My brother is two years older than me.
exercises.explanation: The difference follows the adjective.
The person comes before the thing.

title.zh: 一个人过年多没意思啊
title.en: It's boring to celebrate the Spring Festival alone

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你一个人过年吗？多没意思啊！
lines.pinyin: Nǐ yí ge rén guònián ma? Duō méi yìsi a!
lines.en: Are you spending New Year alone? How boring!

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 是啊。我的房子里有一只小狗。
lines.pinyin: Shì a. Wǒ de fángzi li yǒu yì zhī xiǎo gǒu.
lines.en: Yes. There's just a little dog in my house.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 来我家吧！我们一起包饺子。
lines.pinyin: Lái wǒ jiā ba! Wǒmen yìqǐ bāo jiǎozi.
lines.en: Come to my home! We'll make dumplings together.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 门口站着一位女孩儿。
lines.pinyin: Ménkǒu zhànzhe yí wèi nǚháir.
lines.en: A girl is standing at the door.

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 她姓什么？你跑下去问问。
lines.pinyin: Tā xìng shénme? Nǐ pǎo xiàqù wènwen.
lines.en: What's her surname? Run down and ask.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 好，她走进来了。
lines.pinyin: Hǎo, tā zǒu jìnlái le.
lines.en: Okay, she has walked in.

grammar.name: Existential sentences (2)
grammar.explanation: Place + verb + 着 + person or thing says what exists in a place.

examples.pinyin: Lóu xià zhànzhe hěn duō rén.

grammar.name: The adverb of degree 多
grammar.explanation: 多 + adjective + 啊 is an exclamation: "how...!"

grammar.name: Compound complement of direction
grammar.explanation: 上, 下, 进, 出, 回 and 过 can join 来 or 去, then follow a verb to show direction. A place goes before the final 来 or 去.

examples.pinyin: Wǒmen zǒu huí jiā qù ba.

exercises.explanation: Place + verb + 着 + person shows what is there.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 多……啊 means "how...!"
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: The place comes first.
多……啊 frames the exclamation.

title.en: I want to go to China again

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你去过几次中国？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ qùguo jǐ cì Zhōngguó?
lines.en: How many times have you been to China?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 我去过两次北京。我还想再去一次。
lines.pinyin: Wǒ qùguo liǎng cì Běijīng. Wǒ hái xiǎng zài qù yí cì.
lines.en: I've been to Beijing twice. I want to go again.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你看过颐和园吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ kànguo Yíhé Yuán ma?
lines.en: Have you seen the Summer Palace?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 看过一次，门票不贵。这次我买好机票了。
lines.pinyin: Kànguo yí cì, ménpiào bú guì. Zhè cì wǒ mǎi hǎo jīpiào le.
lines.en: Once, and the tickets aren't expensive. I've bought my plane ticket this time.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 你的老师有三十岁吗？
lines.pinyin: Nǐ de lǎoshī yǒu sānshí suì ma?
lines.en: Is your teacher thirty yet?

lines.speaker: B：
lines.zh: 好像有。我在高中见过她一次。
lines.pinyin: Hǎoxiàng yǒu. Wǒ zài gāozhōng jiànguo tā yí cì.
lines.en: It seems so. I met her once at senior high school.

lines.speaker: A：
lines.zh: 出门前别忘了写好姓名。
lines.pinyin: Chūmén qián bié wàng le xiě hǎo xìngmíng.
lines.en: Before you go out, don't forget to write your full name.

grammar.name: Complement of frequency (1)
grammar.explanation: Number + 次 after a verb shows how many times something happens. A person or place name can go before or after it.

grammar.name: Complement of frequency (2)
grammar.explanation: A thing goes after the number phrase. A pronoun goes before it.

examples.pinyin: Wǒ kànguo liǎng cì zhège diànyǐng.

grammar.name: The 有 sentence (2)
grammar.explanation: 有 + a number shows that something reaches a certain amount.

examples.pinyin: Nǐ de lǎoshī yǒu sānshí suì ma?
examples.en: Is your teacher as old as thirty?

exercises.explanation: 次 counts how many times.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: 有 + number shows reaching an amount.
exercises.label: Choose the word that fits

exercises.explanation: A pronoun goes before the number phrase.
Place names can follow the number phrase.
